description: Ramp on inp crosses a 0.55 V reference at t=550 ns, midway between sampling edges; the decision must appear at the first later rising clock edge (t=600 ns) plus td, measured at the out 50% crossing. The reference sits between edges on purpose: a crossing coincident with an edge (the earlier 0.5 V form) is a race the contract does not adjudicate, and the real simulator decides it one cycle early.
dut: X1 inp inn clk out 0 bhv_comparator_clocked_v1 td=2n tedge=1n

relations.derivation: clk PULSE rises 600..601 ns, crossing vth_clk=0.5 at 600.5 ns; + td=2 ns = 602.5 ns. atol covers clk_band traversal and residual bridge/dac delays (~0.25 ns measured); this case bounds the latency at the ns scale, not the ps regularization bound.
